name: metformin
rationale: Unresolved high-count Long COVID questions plus local clinical anchors in Parkinson disease and schizophrenia; prioritize indication transfer, tolerability and formulation boundaries.

name: fluvoxamine
rationale: Direct fatigue/acute-treatment questions and interaction literacy; preserve correction/republication HOLD around DR004 rather than inherit favorable older claims.

name: nirmatrelvir
rationale: Direct extended-course question; fetch the nirmatrelvir/ritonavir regimen without treating unboosted nirmatrelvir as tested or counting ritonavir again to inflate30.

name: naltrexone
rationale: Several observed questions about formulation, nonresponse, documentation and distinct uses; no CP28 anchor, so this is an honest acquisition gap.

name: pramipexole
rationale: Direct depression/anhedonia response, withdrawal and access questions. CP28 has an ASD lead only, which is not depression support.

name: sirolimus
rationale: Direct healthspan/ovarian-aging/periodontal and interaction questions plus cross-cancer background; longevity goals stay uncounted, with no disease-outcome transfer.

name: itraconazole
rationale: Mandatory owner-selected cancer-first drug. Several cancer contexts in CP28 justify a drug hub and disease-specific fetches; no direct itraconazole Reddit thread found in existing map.

name: ivermectin
rationale: Observed cancer cure/maintenance claims make original human evidence, failures, treatment substitution and harms valuable; candidate mentions do not demonstrate cancer benefit.

name: mebendazole
rationale: Direct ovarian-maintenance/palliative questions, plus local GBM background. Separate monotherapy, adjunct use, compounds and tumor histology.

name: fenbendazole
rationale: Direct cure-claim literacy lead; CP28 contains a review of combination with rapamycin in ovarian cancer. Veterinary/human status and monotherapy versus combination require explicit retrieval; no benefit presumed.

name: guanfacine
rationale: Exact cognitive-symptom question, although sparse; no CP28 pair anchor. Useful gap page rather than invented evidence.

name: maraviroc
rationale: Observed access question names this drug, not these tumor indications. Cross-cancer reuse is an editorial extension supported by corpus tables.

name: atorvastatin
rationale: Observed drug/access mention; local GBM/cancer leads plus a no-added-benefit vitiligo trial make safety and selective-result literacy useful.

name: rituximab
rationale: Access question names drug; small vitiligo pilot offers an explicitly indirect new-condition example. Do not imply demand or efficacy for vitiligo from the access thread.

name: celecoxib
rationale: Mentioned in Long COVID combination thread excluded from primary demand scoring; retain provenance and sparse/context-only status. Cancer and antimicrobial contexts are separate.

name: minocycline
rationale: One corpus drug spans multiple diseases and contrasting positive/negative accounts, especially ALS and MS; no exact drug question in existing Reddit map.

name: doxycycline
rationale: Connect periodontal translation question to an explicitly different drug, plus cancer/host-inflammation context; not a direct doxycycline demand claim.

name: disulfiram
rationale: Cancer translation and original antimicrobial experiments offer a cross-indication source-reading example; clinical cancer evidence must be fetched independently.

name: propranolol
rationale: Cross-tumor repurposing tables fit the observed cancer headline-to-human-evidence question; no drug-specific Reddit demand in existing map.

name: simvastatin
rationale: Cancer leads and worsening in a placebo-controlled vitiligo account provide a useful negative-evidence comparison; drug-specific demand absent.

name: niclosamide
rationale: Cancer repurposing and formulation/exposure translation lead; source tables support discovery only.

name: hydroxychloroquine
rationale: COVID failure and itraconazole cancer-combination context help compare indirect mechanisms with clinical outcomes; not observed direct drug demand.

name: aspirin
rationale: Cancer prevention/treatment separation plus MS computational candidate supports two observed evidence-literacy themes; no direct aspirin demand measured.

name: pioglitazone
rationale: Sarcopenia and residual-leukemia background gives cross-condition reuse; links to healthspan/exercise demand are editorial, not direct.

name: memantine
rationale: Specific GBM trial-table lead supports an observed glioblastoma adjunct question; ASD computational input is separate context.

name: sildenafil
rationale: Drug-specific GBM/pancreatic table leads fit broad cancer adjunct/translation questions; no direct drug-specific Reddit signal.

name: valproic acid
rationale: Cancer epigenetic/AML background can populate mechanism-to-patient boundaries; no direct drug demand assumed.

name: vorinostat
rationale: Source-located original computational Crohn candidate provides a clean test of the observed modeling question; no treatment effect inferred.

name: clomipramine
rationale: A second original computational Crohn candidate enables candidate comparison without presenting the screen as a clinical trial.

name: thalidomide
rationale: Established repurposing history in myeloma and distinct speculative uses make a boundary/safety case; no contemporary efficacy inference from textbook status.
